events.title: The Surrealist Book: Tomorrow Lives in Mirrors
events.what: Opening Sunday: rare artists’ books, collage-filled sketchbooks and sculptural bindings by Surrealist artists including Dalí, Cahun and Unica Zürn. Member previews Oct 1–3; public access starts Oct 4.
events.when: Oct 4, 2026–Jan 23, 2027 · 10:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; Fridays until 8:30 p.m.
events.cost: Adult admission $30; special exhibitions included. NY State residents can reserve free Friday evening tickets.
events.imageAlt: Unica Zürn, Oracle and Spectacle, Book IV, 1960. MoMA; gift of Helen and Sam Zell. Photo: Ben Blackwell. © Verlag Brinkmann & Bose, Berlin.

events.title: Last weekend: Peggy Weil’s Core Memory
events.what: Two immersive films turn polar ice and California rock cores into portraits of deep time on MoMA’s 24-foot lobby screen. This is the final weekend before the installation closes Sunday.
events.where: MoMA · Garden Lobby, Floor 1 · 11 West 53rd Street
events.when: Through Oct 4 · Fri 10:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; Sat–Sun 10:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.
events.cost: Museum adult admission $30. NY State residents can reserve free tickets for Friday 5:30–8:30 p.m.
events.imageAlt: Peggy Weil, 88 Cores, 2017. Digital video with score by Celia Hollander; still courtesy of the artist.

events.title: Sarah Michelson: nowhere

events.cost: Included with museum admission; adults $30. NY State residents can reserve free Friday evening admission.
